full_details: Larkham had the court rolls in a row. You kept the hearing that waits for the word light, and you let go a better word for the Friar and a turn in the Nurse's lament. Sam said you had obeyed the rule that is mostly applied to boys. Heminges did not praise you. He went on. Larkham's boy carried four lines down to the Bell with the letter of the 16th and the six lines of the 24th. The four lines say the lovers are played on Saturday. You played Gaunt in the afternoon in the cut book. The deposition stayed out. At the Bell, Hobbins read the line back and took twopence for one letter. The 60s did not go. No parcel.
one_sentence: You mended one vault cue, let two attractive changes go, and heard Hobbins read Saturday back at twopence.
title: One fault mended, and the packet sent by the boy
